## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      18 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 08.06.2026 - 23.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Tee00077_, 23.08.2026, 1/5: "Genuinely use to be a game changing app but now it’s incredibly buggy to the point where I reset my 15 min limit EIGHT TIMES in a row to access an app. Absolutely tragic and given this only happened post major update I can’t imagine it isn’t intentional. Shame on them."
            2. _Bill_The_Window_Man_, 21.08.2026, 1/5: "This app is borderline unusable now it get worse every update, the UI becomes worse to use, core features harder to access, whole app is slower."
            3. _C0NN0RAD0_, 21.08.2026, 1/5: "I used to really love opal but the last few months it’s went really down hill and very buggy, I often find it not locking apps at the end of breaks, certain rules not staying paused or reset despite asking them to be reset or paused for xyz time, the app frequently freezing. I can no longer rely on it to reliably enforce screen time and habits."
<!--/ir-theme-->
